title: Frequency Domain Biot--Allard Equations for Isotropic and Anisotropic Poroelastic Media: Two-field formulations and iterative splitting
summary: We present a frequency-domain formulation of Biot's dynamic poroelastic equations with frequency-dependent dissipation (Biot--Allard) for anisotropic, heterogeneous media with memory effects. Two equivalent two-field representations--a displacement-pressure and a velocity-pressure-rate formulation--enable stabilized iterative splitting. While coupling operators generally lack an adjoint or skew-adjoint relationship at finite frequencies, the velocity--pressure-rate representation restores a skew-adjoint structure in the quasi-static limit.
